title: Sam Altman on focus: saying no 97 times out of 100 and product discipline
summary: A Business Insider piece pairing Altman's views on focus with Steve Jobs and Warren Buffett. Altman praises discipline and saying no in product leadership, and says the founder sets the company's focus. It is a secondhand report with short Altman quotes from a 20VC podcast and his 2014 Stanford lecture.

principles.text: Great product leaders have discipline: focus, deciding what to say no to, and speaking on behalf of the user.
principles.quote: Discipline was the first word that came to mind. Focus, what we're going to say no to, like really trying to speak on behalf of the user about why we would do something or not do something.

principles.text: The founder sets the company's focus; whatever they care about becomes what everyone works on.
principles.quote: The founder really does set the focus. Whatever the founder cares about, whatever the founders think are the key goals — that's going to be what the whole company focuses on.

principles.text: Staying focused means saying no far more often than yes, and it takes conscious effort.
principles.quote: You know, you're saying no 97 times out of 100.

principles.text: Focus is critical, especially for a founder.
